scoring.formula: 100 * count(PASS) / count(PASS, FAIL, UNVERIFIED); N/A is excluded. Round to one decimal place.
scoring.interpretation: Evidence-coverage percentage only, not a readiness percentage. UNVERIFIED is not PASS and stays in the denominator. A domain with no applicable criteria has no score (N/A), not 100%.
scoring.overall: Same formula over all domain criteria, excluding N/A.
